intro.text: Synera Studio Inc (the “Company”) was incorporated under the laws of the State of Wyoming on April 4, 2025. The Company’s fiscal year ends on June 30. The Company is a startup company engaged in the design and animation services industry. Because the Company was incorporated on April 4, 2025, there were no operations or cash flows during the corresponding prior-year periods.
